text: Hello and welcome to Fuel Stop and
Coaching. My name is Blake Townend. Week
one of the FF1600 Rookie Series fixed at
Summit Point Raceway.
This lap was completed on lap nine.
Brake bias set to 53.5.
Approaching turn one, brake just before
the free cone. Keep brake pressure of
80% and into second gear. Get back to
power just before you reach the apex.
Hard on the throttle and follow the
lighter gray tarmac. Bring the car to
the inside for turn two to shorten track
distance.
Approaching turn three, I keep the car
in third gear. Brake in line with the
access road on the right using max 30%
pressure. Be patient with the inputs as
we get to the late apex. It's easy to
overdrive this corner and exit.
Just before we get to the apex of turn
four, lift off the throttle some to
allow the front tires to bite. Keep car
in the middle on exit ready for turn
five. Use the dirt on the left of the
track as a braking reference. Peak at
70-ish percent to get rotation through
trail braking.
Second gear. Bring the car back to the
left for turn six using a small amount
of brake pressure to get the car turned
into the corner. Run the car middle left
ready for turn seven.
Avoid running over the curbs through
turn seven and eight.
Bring the car back to the left, full
throttle in turn nine. Round the inside
curb and use all of the track on exit.
Entering, in my opinion, the hardest
corner, turn 10. Brake as soon as you
see the pit road open. Aim for 40% brake
pressure and maximize rotation through
trail braking. Take a late downshift
into third gear. Get as close to the
inside curve without completely running
over it. Back the power right away, the
car will run wide on exit. Avoid the
gravel at all costs.
That was a 1 minute 15.932.
